beats.summary: Michael considers faking a fire to discipline Stanley, but Dwight pressures him to take control.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, everybody, shh! So, earlier today, Stanley sassed me, and Toby gave me some suggestions on how to discipline him.

beats.summary: Kevin compliments Pam on her glasses, leading to a conversation about glasses and attractiveness.

evidence.snippet: Kevin: Hey Pam, I really like your glasses.

beats.summary: Creed makes a comment about blind jazz musicians and expresses a desire to see Pam topless.

evidence.snippet: Creed: A lot of jazz cats are blind, but they can play the piano like nobody's business. I'd like to put the piano in front of Pam without her glasses and see what happens. I'd also like to see her topless.
